geoKnowledge.title: GEO Knowledge Base
geoKnowledge.description: Learn the basics and best practices of GEO (Geographic Optimization) to help your website stand out in AI-powered search engines.

whyGeoPoints: With the rise of AI-powered search engines and assistants, traditional SEO methods are no longer sufficient.
GEO optimization ensures your website gets optimal search visibility across different geographic locations and language environments.
Through GEO optimization, you can enhance brand awareness and influence in your target markets.
GEO optimization helps improve local search rankings, attracting more potential customers.
sections.contentLocalizationDesc: Create content tailored to specific regions and language groups, ensuring your message resonates with local users.
contentLocalizationPoints: Create content in local languages to avoid semantic deviations from literal translation.
Consider local cultural customs and holidays when creating content.
Use local examples and case studies to enhance content relevance.
sections.technicalOptimizationDesc: Implement technical measures to ensure your website loads quickly and provides a good user experience globally.
technicalOptimizationPoints: Use Content Delivery Network (CDN) to accelerate global access.
Optimize website loading speed to reduce user wait times.
Ensure the website displays correctly across different devices and browsers.
sections.regionalTrafficDesc: Track visit volume from different regions to understand which markets your content is most popular in.
sections.languagePreferenceDesc: Analyze user language usage to optimize multilingual content strategy.
sections.searchTrendsDesc: Monitor search trends in different regions to adjust content strategy in response to changes.

scoreCard.description: How well your site is optimized for AI search engines

categoryDescriptions.HTTPS: Verifies HTTPS is enabled, the certificate is valid, and HTTP traffic redirects to HTTPS. AI engines preferentially trust encrypted resources; unencrypted sites lose visibility in citations and ranking.
categoryDescriptions.robots.txt: Parses allow/block rules in robots.txt for AI crawlers such as GPTBot, ClaudeBot and PerplexityBot, and flags configurations where a wildcard (User-agent: *) accidentally blocks AI access.
categoryDescriptions.sitemap.xml: Confirms sitemap.xml exists, is referenced from robots.txt, and reports URL count and freshness, helping AI engines discover and revisit content efficiently.
categoryDescriptions.llms.txt: Detects whether llms.txt (the LLM-friendly crawling protocol) is published and whether it points at the canonical content. This emerging standard materially improves citation odds.
categoryDescriptions..well-known Discovery: Inspects /.well-known/ for metadata files such as ai-plugin.json and security.txt so AI platforms can auto-discover capabilities and contact endpoints.
categoryDescriptions.AI Crawl Readiness: Comprehensively checks whether AI crawler agents can reach the site: status codes, redirect chains, timeouts, CDN gating and UA blocking are evaluated.
categoryDescriptions.Structured Data: Scans JSON-LD / Microdata / RDFa structured data and reports coverage of Organization, Article, Product, FAQ and HowTo schemas with field-level validation.
categoryDescriptions.Schema Breadcrumbs & Knowledge Panel: Checks BreadcrumbList, Organization and Person schemas that feed knowledge panels and influence whether AI engines treat the entity as authoritative.
categoryDescriptions.URL Normalization: Verifies URL normalization: trailing slash consistency, canonical tags, parameter hygiene and duplicate paths to prevent crawl waste and authority dilution.
categoryDescriptions.Meta Tags: Audits coverage of title, meta description, Open Graph, Twitter Card, canonical and viewport — the signals AI summaries rely on most heavily.
categoryDescriptions.Mobile-Friendliness & Page Weight: Assesses mobile readability, viewport configuration, font and tap-target sizing, and measures HTML payload weight. Heavy pages get truncated by AI crawlers.
categoryDescriptions.Content Accessibility: Checks alt text, heading hierarchy and ARIA labels. Accessible content is consistently easier for AI engines to parse and extract.
categoryDescriptions.Content Quality for AI: AI-oriented content quality scoring: originality, information density, sectioning, citations and freshness — all gates for whether content is worth quoting.
categoryDescriptions.AI-Specific Optimization: Dedicated AI-engine optimization: FAQ schema, structured answers, explicit factual statements and source attribution measurably increase citation probability.
categoryDescriptions.AI Answer Format Optimization: Evaluates whether the page uses Q&A headings, bullet lists, tables and definition blocks that AI engines prefer when extracting answer snippets.
categoryDescriptions.Technical Crawlability: Inspects status codes, redirect chain length, JS-render dependence, slow responses and error pages — the typical crawl blockers.
categoryDescriptions.Outbound Links & Media: Assesses outbound link quality, nofollow ratio and accessibility of images and video. AI engines use outbound citations as authority signals.
categoryDescriptions.Multilingual Content Depth: Checks hreflang, language tagging and multilingual page coverage — directly affecting how often AI answers in other languages cite the site.
categoryDescriptions.Multi-Page Sampling: Samples multiple inner pages to confirm site-wide consistency, so optimization is not concentrated on the homepage at the expense of landing pages.
categoryDescriptions.Search Engine & AI Platform Registration: Checks indexing across Google, Bing, Brave, Perplexity and other AI platforms, including Search Console / Bing Webmaster registration status.
categoryDescriptions.Authority & Trust Signals: Evaluates off-site authority: backlinks, brand mentions, Wikipedia / Wikidata records and press coverage — the strongest inputs to AI citation ranking.
categoryDescriptions.Social Signals: Measures presence and activity on LinkedIn, Twitter / X, YouTube and Reddit. AI training data weights these sources heavily.
categoryDescriptions.Cross-Platform Content Distribution: Checks coverage on GitHub, npm, PyPI, Stack Overflow, Medium and similar platforms to expand the AI training-data surface area.

pdfReport.title: GEO Readiness Report
pdfReport.subtitle: Professional analysis of your site's visibility to AI search engines

scoreLevels.excellent: Excellent — your site already has strong visibility to mainstream AI search engines. Maintain coverage and keep building authority signals.
scoreLevels.good: Good — solid overall, with several optimizations that can meaningfully improve AI citation rate.
scoreLevels.average: Average — key AI protocols and structured data are partially missing. Prioritize closing the foundational gaps.
scoreLevels.poor: Weak — multiple core checks failed; AI engines will struggle to crawl or cite your content as it stands.
scoreLevels.critical: Critical — the site lacks the foundations of AI visibility and needs a systematic remediation pass.

pdfReport.appendixSection: Appendix: How to read this report
pdfReport.appendixBody: This report is generated automatically by GEO Checker. Every check is grounded in publicly verifiable signals. Status meanings: Pass = meets AI-friendly standards; Warn = does not block access but lowers ranking weight; Fail = directly blocks AI crawling or citation; Info = neutral data, FYI only. Address Fail items first, then Warn items.
pdfReport.noFix: No fix needed, or no specific recommendation available.
pdfReport.topFixesIntro: The following items are ordered by severity. Start with the failures.
pdfReport.noFailItems: No failing items. Focus on the warnings below to push the score higher.

story.paragraph1: GEO AI was founded in 2024 by a group of professionals passionate about artificial intelligence and search engine optimization. We observed that as large language models (LLMs) rapidly evolve, traditional SEO methods are no longer sufficient for the new search paradigm.
